title: Certify every base online user and administrator journey
digest_scope: Recursively lexicographically key-sorted compact UTF-8 JSON serialization of base_online_receipt, with no trailing newline, followed by SHA-256
acceptance_observations: CD.J01 through CD.J09 execute through the public application install and authenticated terminal/session routes. All 17 installed base transactions and all 17 BMS maps have selected-route screen evidence.

Seven committed business mutations cover account, card, transaction, bill-payment, report-queue, and administrator user lifecycle state with exact record, queue, or dataset comparison. The pinned COCRDUPC source reconstructs its updated card record with a blank CVV, and the exact-source oracle records that outcome explicitly.

BMS dynamic protection and FSET behavior preserve protected account, card, and hidden expiry values across HTTP and TN3270 input without exposing secret fields. Continuations and field authority survive durable restart.

Injected second-resource failure restores both account and customer records through CICS rollback. Regular-user denial, concurrent-session isolation, suspended-session restart, input bounds, and screen-resource bounds all fail closed or complete exactly as required.
